items.source: this spec for further declaration of the request
items.translation: 本规范用于请求的进一步声明。

items.source: Variant of body(Publisher, Class) that allows providing element type information with generics.
items.translation: body(Publisher, Class) 的变体，允许使用泛型提供元素类型信息。

items.source: producer - the producer to write to the request. This must be a Publisher or another producer adaptable to a Publisher via ReactiveAdapterRegistry
items.translation: `producer` - 用于写入请求的生成器。它必须是一个 `Publisher`，或者另一个可通过 ReactiveAdapterRegistry 适配为 `Publisher` 的生成器。

items.source: publisher - the request body data
items.translation: publisher - 请求体数据

items.source: This method invokes the body(BodyInserter) method on the underlying WebClient.
items.translation: 此方法在底层的 `WebClient` 上调用body(BodyInserter) 方法。

items.source: Set the body to the given Object value. This method invokes the bodyValue method on the underlying WebClient.
items.translation: 将 body 设置为给定的 `Object` 值。此方法会调用底层 `WebClient 上的bodyValue 方法。

items.source: Set the body from the given Publisher. Shortcut for body(BodyInserter) with a Publisher inserter.
items.translation: 从给定的 Publisher 设置 body。这是带有 Publisher 插入器 的body(BodyInserter) 的快捷方式。

items.source: Set the body from the given producer. This method invokes the body(Object, Class) method on the underlying WebClient.
items.translation: 从给定的 producer 设置 body。此方法会在底层的 `WebClient` 上调用body(Object, Class) 方法。

items.source: Set the body from the given producer. This method invokes the body(Object, ParameterizedTypeReference) method on the underlying WebClient.
items.translation: 从给定的 producer 设置 body。此方法会在底层的 WebClient 上调用 body(Object, ParameterizedTypeReference) 方法。

items.source: Set the media type of the body, as specified by the Content-Type header.
items.translation: 设置正文的媒体类型，如Content-Type 标头中指定。

items.source: Set the length of the body in bytes, as specified by the Content-Length header.
items.translation: 设置以 Content-Length 标头指定的字节数作为正文长度。

items.source: Set the body from the given producer.
items.translation: 从给定的生产者设置主体。

items.translation: S - Publisher 的类型

items.translation: body - 要写入请求体的值

items.source: elementClass - the class of elements contained in the publisher

items.source: elementTypeRef - the type reference of elements contained in the publisher
items.translation: elementTypeRef - 发布器中所包含元素的类型引用

items.source: elementClass - the class of elements contained in the producer
items.translation: elementClass - 生产者中包含的元素类

items.source: elementTypeRef - the type reference of elements contained in the producer
items.translation: elementTypeRef - 生产者中包含的元素的类型引用

items.source: inserter - the body inserter to use
items.translation: inserter - 要使用的主体插入器

items.source: Set the body of the request to the given BodyInserter.
items.translation: 将请求的正文设置为给定的BodyInserter。

items.source: Set the body from the given Publisher.

items.translation: 将主体设置为给定的 `Object` 值。

items.translation: 提供请求主体的规范。
